_note: Per-chain metadata for the seeder. `rpc` is a public default; override any chain by exporting its `rpcEnvVar` in ../.env. `${INFURA_KEY}` in an rpc is substituted from .env. `gasPriceGwei` (null = let the node pick) is forwarded to forge as --with-gas-price; some chains have a network floor.

sepolia.note: FREE testnet. Fund the deployer from a Sepolia faucet, then seed a WETH + MINT-token pool at zero real cost.

hyperevm.note: Real HYPE. Big-blocks mode was needed for the large DEPLOY txs; seeding txs are small (well under 3M gas) so standard blocks are fine.

robinhood.note: Real ETH. Low base fee (~0.02 gwei); 0.05 gwei clears comfortably.

ink.note: Real ETH, very cheap L2. WETH = 0x42..06.

megaeth.note: Testnet. If this public RPC is wrong for your endpoint, override with MEGAETH_RPC_URL in .env.

xlayer.note: Gas paid in OKB. Base fee ~0.021 gwei; 0.05 gwei clears.

tempo.note: 20 gwei NETWORK FLOOR (txs below it are rejected). Gas is paid in pathUSD (ERC-20). The deployment weth9 here is a routing wrapper only; a WETH-side pool needs you to already hold that wrapper token — auto-wrap of native will NOT work on Tempo. Set TEMPO_RPC_URL in .env.
